I completely understand why someone would want to discourage the homeless from sleeping in their entrance way but spikes are pretty medieval. To be fair to the property owner, unless that is an entrance to Goldman Sachs, they probably haven't contributed to the homeless situation any more that the rest of us yet the bear more of the burden. I suggest that if these spikes are giving you a negative, visceral reaction - turn off your computer and get down to your nearest homeless shelter and help out! Go donate some of the old food in your pantry that you're not going to eat. Go through your closet and pull out all of the excess clothes you never wear and donate it. Stop bitching at the miserable-but-completely-predictable consequences of homelessness and DO SOMETHING ABOUT IT!
